name: hub-arrival-wake
description: plugins.hub.arrival_wake decides which peers spend a model call when an agent comes online, and a folder's own .kollab/config.json beats the global file. The global file says all, the folder says none: a peer joining wakes nobody and the notice still shows. The folder file is then rewritten while the app runs: all wakes every peer, koordinator wakes only the koordinator. The koordinator (a daemon with this window attached) plus detached agents in a throwaway HOME, a fake model whose replies start with pong:, no keyring (lib/hub_arrival_probe.sh). /config lists the setting as a dropdown showing the folder's value.

config.command: sh -c 'R=$(pwd); H=$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-arrival-wake.path"); cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 exec "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py"'

teardown.description: stop the agents and the fake model

steps.description: throwaway HOME: global arrival_wake all, the folder's none, a fake model
status bar up (daemon forked, this window attached)

steps.title: folder none beats global all: nobody wakes, the notice still shows

steps.command: p() { sh tests/tmux/lib/hub_arrival_probe.sh "$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-arrival-wake.path")" "$@"; }; p join lapis

steps.description: the arrival notice reaches the koordinator

steps.title: folder all: every peer wakes (config reloaded while running)

steps.description: rewrite the folder file to all, then sapphire joins
steps.command: p() { sh tests/tmux/lib/hub_arrival_probe.sh "$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-arrival-wake.path")" "$@"; }; p folder all; sleep 3; p join sapphire

p() { sh tests/tmux/lib/hub_arrival_probe.sh "$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-arrival-wake.path")" "$@"; }; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(p pongs lapis)" -ge 1 ] && { echo 'lapis woke'; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; echo 'lapis never woke'; exit 1

steps.title: folder koordinator: only the koordinator wakes

steps.description: rewrite the folder file to koordinator, peridot joins; lapis and sapphire stay asleep, the koordinator answers
steps.command: p() { sh tests/tmux/lib/hub_arrival_probe.sh "$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-arrival-wake.path")" "$@"; }; p folder koordinator; sleep 12; l0=$(p pongs lapis); s0=$(p pongs sapphire); k0=$(p pongs koordinator); p join peridot; sleep 12; l1=$(p pongs lapis); s1=$(p pongs sapphire); k1=$(p pongs koordinator); if [ "$l0" = "$l1" ] && [ "$s0" = "$s1" ] && [ "$k1" -gt "$k0" ]; then echo 'only the koordinator woke'; else echo "wrong: lapis $l0 -> $l1, sapphire $s0 -> $s1, koordinator $k0 -> $k1"; exit 1; fi

steps.title: /config shows the setting with this folder's value
